'''Rozatta's on Primeday''' was a franchised [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] posting agency that operated during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]] [[Bounty Hunters Guild Handbook|handbook]] noted that Rozatta's on Primeday have more information on bounties then what is listed on a [[Notice of Civil Remandation]].<ref name="Bounty Hunter Code" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rozatta's on Primeday was mentioned in the [[2014]] reference book ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]], [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Ryder Windham]].<ref name="Bounty Hunter Code" />
